_comment: Built-in defaults for the deck-studio skill: the plain template, Arial, a neutral palette. Every script reads this through scripts/config.py. Do not edit this file to use your own template: run  python scripts/use_template.py <template.pptx> --deck <deck folder>  (writes deck-studio.json, which overrides these values) and  --plain  to go back to these defaults.

_notes.wordmark_text: Text drawn top-right of every content slide by the HTML boilerplate. Leave empty for none. If your template's master already draws a logo there, set template_supplies_chrome to true so the translator skips the HTML wordmark and page number instead of doubling them.
_notes.font: Arial is a system font, so nothing is installed. For your own template use_template.py sets the font from the template's theme; install that font on the machine if it is not a system font.
_notes.template: The plain template: the stock 16:9 Office layouts (Title Slide, Section Header, Title Only, Blank, ...), no logo, no footer. Run  python scripts/list_layouts.py  to see the layout names.
_notes.palette: Role names are what the docs refer to. use_template.py replaces the values with your template's theme colours; keep the roles.
_notes.acronyms_extra: Brand names or acronyms genuinely styled in capitals, so typecheck.py does not flag them as shouting.
_notes.default_layout: Substring of the layout name every content slide lands on unless <body data-ppt-layout> says otherwise. When several layouts match, the one whose name contains 'white' or 'light' wins.
